hazards.hazard: Steam leaks through non-tight-shutoff valves FV-A/FV-B into reboilers E-1A/E-1B while C-1 holds ~1,200 gal MNT at atmospheric pressure, heating MNT above 374 °F decomposition temperature → explosive decomposition, vessel rupture, blast to control room 50 ft away
hazards.reason: Steam plant just restored (300 psig at inlets); FV-A/FV-B are control valves, not isolation valves; outlet manual blocks closed but LOTO not applied; DCS had power and hard-drive losses past week; 7 TIs on DCS but NO alarms configured; NO high-temperature interlock; PSV-1 has no design-basis records

hazards.hazard: No temperature alarms or automatic heat-cutoff interlock on C-1 while steam supply is live → runaway heating from steam leak or erroneous restart proceeds undetected until PSV-1 lifts or explosion occurs
hazards.reason: Eight TIs (seven working) display on DCS but zero alarms configured; no high-temperature interlock exists; emergency shutdown only addresses loss of steam to eductors or cooling water, not over-temperature; operators must notice trend manually

hazards.hazard: Restart initiated without written procedure, without vacuum established (eductors need steam), without confirmed level/temperature monitoring, with steam available at SS-A/SS-B → premature steam admission causes thermal shock, overpressure, or runaway reaction
hazards.reason: No restart procedure exists; no de-inventory procedure; vacuum broken 9 days ago (N2 injected, gauge unreliable); reflux cooler E-2 drained; steam plant back online; restart date unset but steam present; emergency shutdown only reactive

hazards.hazard: PSV-1 (3-inch, 15 psig) on C-1 overhead has no design-basis records and unknown discharge destination → if it relieves (overpressure from steam leak, fire, runaway), MNT vapor discharges uncontrolled, potentially to atmosphere near control room or personnel
hazards.reason: Package explicitly states 'no design-basis records'; discharge location not described; PSV-1 is sole pressure protection for a column with no high-temp interlock and questionable steam isolation

hazards.hazard: Air ingress via drained reflux cooler E-2 or PSV-1 leak into nitrogen-blanketed C-1 at atmospheric pressure → flammable MNT vapour/air mixture in headspace; ignition source (static, hot work, leak) causes internal explosion
hazards.reason: E-2 'drained for tube work' — may be open to atmosphere; N2 injection 9 days ago but 0–200 mmHg gauge 'cannot confirm the result'; column holds 1,200 gal MNT (NFPA flammability 1, flash point >100 °F); no inert-gas monitoring

hazards.hazard: Reboiler E-1A/E-1B tube failure from thermal shock (steam admitted to cold tubes) or condensate-return blockage with steam flowing → tube rupture, steam/MNT cross-contamination, pressure excursion
hazards.reason: C-1 cooled to near ambient during steam-plant turnaround; emergency procedure blocks condensate return but assumes steam control valves closed; if steam leaks past FV-A/FV-B, condensate blocked → water hammer/thermal stress; no tube-leak detection

hazards.hazard: DCS power loss and hard-drive loss in past week compromise FV-A/FV-B closure integrity and temperature indication reliability → valves may drift open, TIs may show stale values, operators unaware
hazards.reason: Two distinct DCS failures restored but root cause unverified; FV-A/FV-B are DCS-operated; all C-1 temperatures displayed only on DCS; no independent local indication or alarm

hazards.hazard: Aniline/MNT control room 50 ft from C-1 (masonry block, sheet-metal roof/sides, glass windows/door) never evaluated for building siting → personnel exposed to blast, fragments, or PSV-1 discharge from C-1 explosion
hazards.reason: Package states control room 'never evaluated for building siting'; glass windows and door offer minimal blast resistance; 50 ft is within credible overpressure zone for 1,200 gal MNT decomposition

hazards.hazard: No de-inventory procedure for C-1 → 1,200 gal MNT held indefinitely in idle column with only manual-valve steam isolation (no LOTO, no blinds) → prolonged exposure to steam-leak risk, seal degradation, unknown MNT stability at ambient
hazards.reason: Feed stopped 4 weeks ago; restart date unset; site LOTO programme 'not applied to steam isolation of an idle column that still contains material'; double block and bleed or blinds not required; MNT decomposition literature notes explosions when 'held moderately hot for long periods'

hazards.hazard: Emergency shutdown procedure for C-1 requires operator action to close FV-A/FV-B and block condensate returns — no automatic trip on high temperature or high pressure → delayed response if steam to eductors fails but reboiler steam persists
hazards.reason: Procedure only covers loss of steam to eductors or cooling water; assumes operators detect and act; no interlock cuts reboiler steam on C-1 high temperature or pressure; chimney-tray high-level alarm unrelated
